description: This file defines the Opportunity class, which models the opportunity entity in the SuiteCRM project. It includes properties for opportunity fields, methods for querying, related data handling, saving, and other business logic related to opportunities.

classes.name: Opportunity
classes.description: Represents a sales opportunity in the SuiteCRM system, encompassing fields for opportunity details, relationships with other entities, and methods for data management.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the opportunity as its summary text.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL SELECT statement to retrieve a list of opportunities with optional filtering, ordering, and join customizations.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query to export opportunity data, including related account and user info.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Loads additional fields for list view if required.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional details such as currency and campaign name for an opportunity record.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts related to the opportunity.

methods.name: update_currency_id
methods.description: Updates the currency and amount fields for a list of opportunity IDs after a currency change.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Returns filtered data for list views, including formatting.

methods.name: get_currency_symbol
methods.description: Returns the currency symbol for the opportunity's currency.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a WHERE clause for a search query based on a search string.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the opportunity instance to the database, setting default values if necessary.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Updates related entity relationships, e.g., account and contacts.

methods.name: set_opportunity_contact_relationship
methods.description: Associates a contact with the opportunity.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Sets notification email content for an opportunity.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates if the bean implements specific interfaces, such as ACL.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Checks user permissions for list view access based on security group and ownership.

methods.name: get_account_detail
methods.description: Retrieves detailed account information related to an opportunity.
